notes: Walkers and mountain bikers use this track together. Keep left and listen for bikes.
The tops between Ces Clark Hut and Pororari Hut are open to strong wind, rain and cloud.
There are no campsites on this track. You must book the huts.

moonlighttops.name: Moonlight Tops Hut
moonlighttops.note: DOC hut. You must book before you go. Facilities: cooking, heating, mattresses, lighting, non-flush toilets. Boil the water before you drink it.

end.note: End of the track at Punakaiki, near the Pancake Rocks.

pois.name: Paparoa tops
pois.text: The highest part of the track, about 1140 m, on the open tops of the Paparoa Range.

pois.name: Croesus Track gold workings
pois.text: The first part of the track follows the Croesus Track, a miners' road from the gold years of the 1860s to the 1900s. Old hotel and battery sites are beside the track.

pois.name: Pororari River gorge
pois.text: Limestone gorge with nīkau palms and deep green pools, in the last hour of the track.

pois.name: Croesus Top Hut
